summary: The labels and submit button inside the Sign Up form became centered while the section heading, card placement, and input contents remain left-aligned, creating an inconsistent form layout.

regressions.explanation: The Username label is centered above a full-width, left-aligned input field and beneath a left-aligned section heading, breaking standard form alignment.
The Password label is centered above a left-aligned input field, creating an inconsistent visual hierarchy with the rest of the left-aligned form.
The Sign Up button shifted from left-aligned to centered within the form card, which appears to be a side effect of unintended centering applied to the form container.
